origin_note: Map decision [INFERENCE]: screen13 is NOT Cloud City proper: brown retail earth (4 f30-33), a dead tree 74, mushrooms 65 and spires 66 are Vale/Cliffs props, and the gold-brick corner (the city street) enters bottom-right -> the Map 13 summit / city edge. Earth z=0 on the 128 lattice. The cloud patches and the gold corner FLOAT over the earth (Douglas 2026-10-30): in 1994 they draw over the tree crown (74 f0 tops out at local 80), the mushroom behind it and the spires' feet, while the Avatar's legs draw over the lower patch, so he stands on the cloud and the props stand on ground below it. They are laid at local z 97 (cloud 96 + 1), 12 view-ray steps up from the shot's z 1 (+384,+384,+96: every pixel unchanged), clear of the tree's top by 16; origin_world must add the summit z (120).
